terrain.reason: Terrain is a mesh; sample terrain collision surface at each target XY.

validation_requirements: Resolve each victim model's collision geometry and compute its ground-contact point; do not assume model-origin Z is ground altitude.
Sample the terrain collision mesh beneath each target XY to obtain local terrain height.
Use Gazebo camera image acquisition timestamp and interpolated PX4 pose at that timestamp.
Record camera optical-to-body-FRD transform and validate its axis convention against the SDF joint/link frames.
Compare projected camera-GPS footpoint against Gazebo ground-truth victim ground-contact coordinates.
Report horizontal error, vertical/range error, sample count, and uncertainty separately.
Label results simulation-validated only; they do not constitute real-world empirical calibration.
Keep coordinator operational calibration approval and dispatchability disabled.
not_established_by_this_world_file: Terrain altitude in the PX4 home absolute-altitude datum
